Natural Earth - world country boundaries (public domain)

File:    world.geo.json
Source:  Natural Earth, "Admin 0 - Countries", 1:110m scale
         (ne_110m_admin_0_countries.geojson, repository nvkelso/natural-earth-vector, tag v5.1.2)
         https://www.naturalearthdata.com/
Changes: Antarctica removed; properties reduced to {iso, name}
         (iso = ISO_A2_EH of the source, falling back to ISO_A2 and then to a fixed ADM0_A3 table
         KOS=XK, FRA=FR, NOR=NO when that is -99; left empty for N. Cyprus and Somaliland;
         name = NAME); coordinates rounded to 2 decimals.
SHA-256 of the unmodified source file:   6866c877d39cba9c357620878839b336d569f8c662d3cfab4cb1dbe2d39c977f
SHA-256 of world.geo.json (as bundled):  5639a2568f0f14a602ba21da1310e9aebcc3dc6afb21417e4c96af7d64931e31
